source.text_it: Ogni sei mesi gli estintori presenti sugli autobus vanno svuotati, puliti internamente e ricaricati

records.localized_text: Every six months, bus fire extinguishers must be emptied, cleaned inside and recharged.

source.text_it: Il pulsante di emergenza presente sugli autobus, se premuto, consente l'immediata apertura di tutte le porte del veicolo

records.localized_text: When pressed, the emergency button on a bus immediately opens all vehicle doors.

source.text_it: Il pulsante di emergenza presente sugli autobus, se premuto, consente l'immediata espulsione verso l'esterno dei vetri dei finestrini di sicurezza

records.localized_text: When pressed, the emergency button on a bus immediately ejects the emergency window glass outward.

source.text_it: Il pulsante di emergenza presente sugli autobus, se premuto, consente di lanciare un messaggio di SOS al numero di telefono 118

records.localized_text: When pressed, the emergency button on a bus sends an SOS message to telephone number 118.

source.text_it: Sugli autobus con al massimo trenta posti, deve trovarsi almeno un estintore da otto litri se a schiuma o uno da tre chili se a neve carbonica

records.localized_text: Buses with no more than thirty seats must carry at least one 8-litre foam extinguisher or one 3-kilogram carbon dioxide extinguisher.

source.text_it: Sugli autobus con al massimo trenta posti, deve trovarsi almeno un estintore da cinque chili a polvere

records.localized_text: Buses with no more than thirty seats must carry at least one 5-kilogram powder extinguisher.

source.text_it: Sugli autobus interregionali con più di trenta posti, deve trovarsi almeno un estintore da 200 grammi a schiuma per ogni fila di sedili

records.localized_text: Interregional buses with more than thirty seats must carry at least one 200-gram foam extinguisher per row of seats.

source.text_it: Sugli autobus con più di trenta posti, deve trovarsi almeno un estintore da otto chili a schiuma, oppure due estintori da quattro chili se a neve carbonica

records.localized_text: Buses with more than thirty seats must carry at least one 8-kilogram foam extinguisher or two 4-kilogram carbon dioxide extinguishers.

source.text_it: Durante la stagione invernale, gli estintori presenti sugli autobus possono essere tenuti all'interno del portabagagli

records.localized_text: In winter, bus fire extinguishers may be kept in the luggage compartment.

source.text_it: Ogni sei mesi il conducente deve provare l'estintore presente sull'autobus, azionandolo per due secondi, annotando data ed esito della prova sull'apposita targhetta posta sull'estintore

records.localized_text: Every six months the driver must test the bus fire extinguisher by operating it for two seconds, recording the date and result on its tag.

source.text_it: Gli estintori presenti sugli autobus devono essere controllati ogni dodici mesi

records.localized_text: Bus fire extinguishers must be checked every twelve months.

source.text_it: L'annotazione dell'avvenuto controllo semestrale degli estintori presenti sull'autobus deve essere conservata presso l'azienda titolare del veicolo

records.localized_text: The record of the six-monthly inspection of bus fire extinguishers must be kept at the company owning the vehicle.

source.text_it: Il pulsante di emergenza presente sull'autobus deve trovarsi sotto il sedile del conducente, per evitare il pericolo di azionamento involontario

records.localized_text: The emergency button on a bus must be under the driver's seat to prevent accidental activation.

source.text_it: Sugli autobus interregionali con più di trenta posti e percorso superiore a 500 chilometri, deve essere presente a bordo un medico o un paramedico che si occupi di eventuali soccorsi sanitari

records.localized_text: Interregional buses with more than thirty seats and routes over 500 kilometres must carry a doctor or paramedic to handle medical emergencies.

source.text_it: Le uscite di emergenza presenti sugli autobus con più di trenta posti possono essere solo porte

records.localized_text: Emergency exits on buses with more than thirty seats may only be doors.

source.text_it: E' opportuno che il conducente verifichi, prima di ogni viaggio, la posizione, pulizia e stato generale degli specchi retrovisori del veicolo

records.localized_text: Before every journey, the driver should check the position, cleanliness and general condition of the vehicle's mirrors.

source.text_it: Anche se gli specchi retrovisori sono ben regolati, esistono parti della strada che il conducente non riesce a vedere

records.localized_text: Even when mirrors are correctly adjusted, there are parts of the road the driver cannot see.

source.text_it: Vi sono parti della strada che il conducente riesce a vedere direttamente e altre che può vedere solo di riflesso attraverso gli specchi retrovisori

records.localized_text: The driver can see some parts of the road directly and others only by reflection in the mirrors.

source.text_it: Se gli specchi retrovisori sono ben regolati, non esistono parti della strada che il conducente non possa vedere chiaramente

records.localized_text: If mirrors are correctly adjusted, there are no parts of the road the driver cannot see clearly.

source.text_it: Se gli specchi retrovisori di un lato sono sporchi o danneggiati, non vi sono pericoli se quelli dell’altro lato sono in perfetto ordine

records.localized_text: If mirrors on one side are dirty or damaged, there is no danger if those on the other side are in perfect condition.

source.text_it: Gli specchi retrovisori possono essere integralmente sostituiti da telecamere opportunamente disposte

records.localized_text: Mirrors may be entirely replaced by suitably positioned cameras.

source.text_it: Il proprietario o il conducente devono seguire lo scadenzario degli interventi di manutenzione programmata indicato sul manuale di uso e manutenzione fornito dal costruttore del veicolo

records.localized_text: The owner or driver must follow the scheduled maintenance timetable in the manufacturer's use and maintenance manual.

source.text_it: La pulizia del parabrezza è rilevante anche ai fini del funzionamento e della durata delle spazzole del tergicristallo

records.localized_text: Windshield cleanliness also affects wiper blade operation and life.

source.text_it: Prima di partire occorre verificare la pulizia delle superfici vetrate e degli specchi retrovisori

records.localized_text: Before departure, check the cleanliness of glass surfaces and mirrors.

source.text_it: Vanno verificati periodicamente lo stato di usura e la pressione di gonfiaggio di tutti gli pneumatici

records.localized_text: The wear and inflation pressure of all tires must be checked periodically.

rows.text: The six-monthly check verifies that the extinguisher works; emptying and recharging are separate operations, not required at every check.
evidence: Vigili del Fuoco Fermo, avviso manutenzione estintori 2024, https://www.vigilfuoco.it/sites/default/files/2024-02/Avviso%20procedura%20di%20gara%20estintori.pdf: controllo semestrale distinto da ricarica e collaudo.
Circolare interministeriale 23 marzo 2018, prot. 6575/RU, §§1–4 e nota 2, https://www.uspbari.it/usp/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/1-17-4-2018.pdf: dotazioni, idoneità, manutenzione e targhetta.

rows.text: The emergency button in this question stops the engine; doors use separate controls and do not all open immediately.
evidence: Ministero infrastrutture e trasporti, quiz superiori 2025, quesiti 28864–28870, https://ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/57321/Domande%2BSuperiori%2Bitaliano%2B04%2B04%2B2025/7763ce74-4de6-4ad9-9129-7a7c21efd1fb: controllo, targhetta e comando di arresto motore previsti nel contesto del quiz.
UNECE R107 rev.5, allegato 3 §§7.5.4 e 7.6, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/2015/R107r5e.pdf: sede e accessibilità estintori, uscite e comandi porte.

rows.text: The button in this question stops the engine; it does not eject the glass. Window exits have their own devices, such as a tool for breaking the glass.
evidence: Ministero infrastrutture e trasporti, quiz superiori 2025, quesiti 28864–28870, https://ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/57321/Domande%2BSuperiori%2Bitaliano%2B04%2B04%2B2025/7763ce74-4de6-4ad9-9129-7a7c21efd1fb: controllo, targhetta e comando di arresto motore previsti nel contesto del quiz.
UNECE R107 rev.7 allegato 3 §7.6.8, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/2020/R107r7e.pdf: apertura o rottura dei finestrini di emergenza.

rows.text: The emergency button described in the question stops the engine; it is not a control for automatically sending a message to 118.
evidence: Ministero infrastrutture e trasporti, quiz superiori 2025, quesiti 28864–28870, https://ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/57321/Domande%2BSuperiori%2Bitaliano%2B04%2B04%2B2025/7763ce74-4de6-4ad9-9129-7a7c21efd1fb: controllo, targhetta e comando di arresto motore previsti nel contesto del quiz.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but the wording is ambiguous: “at least one” can refer to the number of extinguishers. Historically, up to 30 seats required at least one 5-litre foam or one 2-kg CO₂ unit; a larger suitable approved unit is not automatically inadequate. Check applicable requirements and approved equivalents.
evidence: DM 18 April 1977 annex §5.5.8.1, official Gazzetta supplement printed p. 6, inspected original SHA-256 fc395ed35fa70499c519865e91fcaed1838bf8535c961667b4794d6245696f50: up to 30 seats at least 5 L foam or 2 kg CO2; over 30 at least 5 L foam or two 2 kg CO2; approved equivalent effectiveness permitted. https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/gu/1977/05/19/135/so/0/sg/pdf

Joint Interior/MIT circular 6575/RU 23 March 2018 explains approved equivalents and modern suitability; its summary contains a unit/30-seat boundary discrepancy, so historic original is used for that wording. https://www.uspbari.it/usp/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/1-17-4-2018.pdf

The printed FALSO is retained; the literal wording permits a reading about extinguisher count rather than claiming a minimum size. Larger suitable approved units are not automatically inadequate; the historic lower threshold alone does not refute the statement. The official intended interpretation is not established.

rows.text: The circular regards powder extinguishers as unsuitable inside buses: dispersed powder can irritate eyes and mucous membranes.
evidence: Circolare interministeriale 23 marzo 2018, prot. 6575/RU, §§1–4 e nota 2, https://www.uspbari.it/usp/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/1-17-4-2018.pdf: dotazioni, idoneità, manutenzione e targhetta.

rows.text: Equipment is not calculated as one small extinguisher per row. For buses with more than thirty seats the circular specifies a foam extinguisher or two CO₂ extinguishers meeting the stated specifications.
evidence: Circolare interministeriale 23 marzo 2018, prot. 6575/RU, §§1–4 e nota 2, https://www.uspbari.it/usp/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/1-17-4-2018.pdf: dotazioni, idoneità, manutenzione e targhetta.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but the wording is ambiguous: two 4-kg CO₂ units may meet the historical minimum of two 2-kg units for over 30 seats if suitable and approved. The historical alternative was one 5-litre foam unit: kilograms and litres are not directly equivalent. Check applicable requirements and approved equivalents.
evidence: DM 18 April 1977 annex §5.5.8.1, official Gazzetta supplement printed p. 6, inspected original SHA-256 fc395ed35fa70499c519865e91fcaed1838bf8535c961667b4794d6245696f50: up to 30 seats at least 5 L foam or 2 kg CO2; over 30 at least 5 L foam or two 2 kg CO2; approved equivalent effectiveness permitted. https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/eli/gu/1977/05/19/135/so/0/sg/pdf

The question states 8 kg foam; the original specifies 5 litres, and units cannot be converted without composition. Two 4-kg CO2 units exceed the historical two 2-kg minimum, but actual approval and suitability must be checked.
Joint Interior/MIT circular 6575/RU 23 March 2018 on approved equivalents: https://www.uspbari.it/usp/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/1-17-4-2018.pdf

The printed FALSO is retained; the literal wording permits a reading about extinguisher count rather than claiming a minimum size. Larger suitable approved units are not automatically inadequate; the historic lower threshold alone does not refute the statement. The official intended interpretation is not established.

rows.text: The extinguisher must remain in its designated location and be easy to retrieve in an emergency; winter does not justify storing it in the luggage compartment.
evidence: UNECE R107 rev.5, allegato 3 §§7.5.4 e 7.6, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/2015/R107r5e.pdf: sede e accessibilità estintori, uscite e comandi porte.
Circolare interministeriale 23 marzo 2018, prot. 6575/RU, §§1–4 e nota 2, https://www.uspbari.it/usp/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/1-17-4-2018.pdf: dotazioni, idoneità, manutenzione e targhetta.

rows.text: Periodic inspection is entrusted to competent personnel; it does not consist of discharging the extinguisher for two seconds. Work is recorded on its tag.
evidence: Circolare interministeriale 23 marzo 2018, prot. 6575/RU, §§1–4 e nota 2, https://www.uspbari.it/usp/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/1-17-4-2018.pdf: dotazioni, idoneità, manutenzione e targhetta.

Vigili del Fuoco Fermo, avviso manutenzione estintori 2024, https://www.vigilfuoco.it/sites/default/files/2024-02/Avviso%20procedura%20di%20gara%20estintori.pdf: controllo semestrale distinto da ricarica e collaudo.

rows.text: The six-monthly periodic check is more frequent than a twelve-month check; waiting a year does not meet that interval.
evidence: Ministero infrastrutture e trasporti, quiz superiori 2025, quesiti 28864–28870, https://ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/57321/Domande%2BSuperiori%2Bitaliano%2B04%2B04%2B2025/7763ce74-4de6-4ad9-9129-7a7c21efd1fb: controllo, targhetta e comando di arresto motore previsti nel contesto del quiz.

Vigili del Fuoco Fermo, avviso manutenzione estintori 2024, https://www.vigilfuoco.it/sites/default/files/2024-02/Avviso%20procedura%20di%20gara%20estintori.pdf: controllo semestrale distinto da ricarica e collaudo.

rows.text: The result must be recorded on the tag attached to the extinguisher so it can be checked on board; keeping a record only at the company does not replace that entry.
evidence: Circolare interministeriale 23 marzo 2018, prot. 6575/RU, §§1–4 e nota 2, https://www.uspbari.it/usp/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/1-17-4-2018.pdf: dotazioni, idoneità, manutenzione e targhetta.

rows.text: The emergency stop button must be within the driver’s reach; under the seat it would not be readily accessible.
evidence: Ministero infrastrutture e trasporti, quiz superiori 2025, quesiti 28864–28870, https://ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/57321/Domande%2BSuperiori%2Bitaliano%2B04%2B04%2B2025/7763ce74-4de6-4ad9-9129-7a7c21efd1fb: controllo, targhetta e comando di arresto motore previsti nel contesto del quiz.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: seat count and journey length alone do not establish that a doctor or paramedic must travel on board. In an accident, arrange the necessary assistance, including first aid where appropriate.
evidence: Regulation (EU) 181/2011 Article 8: carrier provides reasonable and proportionate assistance in immediate practical needs after an accident, including first aid where necessary; this does not itself establish a doctor-on-board rule based on 30 seats/500 km. https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32011R0181
Official superiori quiz question 28890 prints FALSO; no independent general doctor-on-board requirement identified for those thresholds.

rows.text: Emergency exits are not limited to doors: they can also include windows and escape hatches, depending on the vehicle’s configuration.
evidence: UNECE R107 rev.5, allegato 3 §§7.5.4 e 7.6, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/2015/R107r5e.pdf: sede e accessibilità estintori, uscite e comandi porte.

rows.text: Clean, intact mirrors adjusted for the driver allow the available side and rear areas to be checked before setting off.
evidence: DVSA, Carry out bus or coach daily walkaround checks, §§1 e 19, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks: verifiche di specchi, vetri e pneumatici.
Health and Safety Authority Ireland, Bus Driver Walk-Around Check Sheet, punto 1, https://www.hsa.ie/media/eg4lwmzg/bus_driver_walk_around_worksheet.pdf: visibilità e regolazione specchi.

rows.text: Mirrors extend the field of view, but blind spots can remain where a road user is not visible.
evidence: TfL/TRL, Bus Safety Standard: Bus Vision, Blind Spot Mirrors, https://content.tfl.gov.uk/bus-safety-standard-bus-vision.pdf: aree non visibili direttamente né tramite gli specchi su autobus esaminati.

rows.text: The driver sees some areas directly through the windows; mirrors show other side and rear areas indirectly.
evidence: TfL/TRL, Bus Safety Standard: Bus Vision, Blind Spot Mirrors, https://content.tfl.gov.uk/bus-safety-standard-bus-vision.pdf: aree non visibili direttamente né tramite gli specchi su autobus esaminati.

UN Regulation 46, official EU publication, §§2.1 and 2.1.1, inspected in accessible EUR-Lex HTML: indirect-vision devices serve areas not visible directly, and mirrors provide rear, side or front fields of vision. https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2014/46/oj/eng

rows.text: Correct adjustment improves visibility, but does not necessarily eliminate every blind spot around the vehicle.
evidence: TfL/TRL, Bus Safety Standard: Bus Vision, Blind Spot Mirrors, https://content.tfl.gov.uk/bus-safety-standard-bus-vision.pdf: aree non visibili direttamente né tramite gli specchi su autobus esaminati.

rows.text: Mirrors on the two sides show different areas; working mirrors on one side do not restore the view lost on the other.
evidence: DVSA, Carry out bus or coach daily walkaround checks, §§1 e 19, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks: verifiche di specchi, vetri e pneumatici.

TfL/TRL, Bus Safety Standard: Bus Vision, Blind Spot Mirrors, https://content.tfl.gov.uk/bus-safety-standard-bus-vision.pdf: aree non visibili direttamente né tramite gli specchi su autobus esaminati.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: simply fitting any cameras in place of mirrors is not enough. On eligible vehicles, approved camera-monitor systems may replace specified mirrors subject to the applicable fields of view and conditions; cameras are not universally prohibited.
evidence: UNECE Regulation No.46 revision 7 §2.2.6 and Annex 12: camera-monitor indirect-vision systems and approval requirements; applicable vehicle class and field of view determine permissible replacement. https://unece.org/sites/default/files/2024-02/R046r7e%281%29.pdf
Printed FALSO does not establish a general ban on approved camera-monitor systems; interpreting the statement as arbitrary camera replacement is an editorial inference.

rows.text: The manufacturer’s schedule specifies preventive maintenance and its intervals; following it helps keep the vehicle in working order.
evidence: HSE, Inspection, maintenance and repair, Planned maintenance, https://www.hse.gov.uk/workplacetransport/vehicles/inspection.htm: manutenzione periodica e guida del costruttore.

rows.text: Dirt on the windscreen can accumulate on the wiper rubber and impair wiping; keeping the glass clean helps the blades last.
evidence: Bosch, How to Improve the Life of Windshield Wipers?, Keep the Windshield Clean, https://ap.boschaftermarket.com/in/en/news/tips-and-technology/how-to-improve-the-life-of-windshield-wipers/: sporco sul vetro e durata delle spazzole.

rows.text: Clean glass and mirrors keep both direct and reflected views clear, so they should be checked before departure.
evidence: DVSA, Carry out bus or coach daily walkaround checks, §§1 e 19, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks: verifiche di specchi, vetri e pneumatici.
HSE, Safe manoeuvring, A clear view, https://www.hse.gov.uk/workplacetransport/vehicles/safemanoeuvring.htm: visuale da parabrezza, vetri laterali e specchi.

rows.text: Wear and pressure affect tyre performance; checking all wheels helps identify damage or incorrect inflation.
evidence: DVSA, Carry out bus or coach daily walkaround checks, §§1 e 19, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carry-out-psv-daily-walkaround-checks: verifiche di specchi, vetri e pneumatici.
HSE, Inspection, maintenance and repair, Planned maintenance, https://www.hse.gov.uk/workplacetransport/vehicles/inspection.htm: manutenzione periodica e guida del costruttore.

reviewer_evidence: Original Gazzetta 1977 supplement page 6 independently inspected in prior round; 2018 joint circular independently checked, including approved CO₂ units with nominal charge at least 2 kg. Revised 28881 and 28884 visibly acknowledge literal ambiguity and applicable approval.
